messages:
anya: quick follow-up to the quantization RFC: propose an "auto-threshold" that temporarily upgrades precision when a degradation_score exceeds a threshold for N consecutive samples. want to land on schema + ops implications.
sam: runtime latency constraints mean full degscore compute should be async. runtime can keep a tiny counter/window.
lia: agree. runtime emits light signals: OK / WARN / CRITICAL. telemetry computes full degradation and backfills. runtime can use a short sliding window to make immediate decisions.
mike: ops needs a no-deploy override for endpoints. suggest precedence table and a simple API for SREs.
anya: preliminary profile fields: version, id, staleness_hours, signal_window, min_samples, critical_threshold, cooldown_seconds, cost_budget_tokens. example snippet: ```json
{"version":"v1","profiles":[{"id":"fp8-pref","staleness_hours":"72","signal_window":"20","min_samples":"8","critical_threshold":"0.35","cooldown_seconds":"300","cost_budget_tokens":"500000"}]}
```
lia: pick units explicitly: staleness_hours (hours), signal_window (samples), cooldown in seconds. critical_threshold normalized 0-1.
sam: runtime impl notes: keep last N samples per shard, increment consecutive_warning counter, flip when >= min_samples && avg_score > threshold, then start cooldown to avoid oscillation. emit metric `quant_profile.switch_count` and a tag with reason.
mike: cost guard: if upgrading pushes tokens over `cost_budget_tokens`, fallback to default and emit an alert/event. make this per-customer and per-endpoint optional field.
anya: precedence: customer_pin > manual_override > auto_threshold > default_profile. documenting this in spec.
lia: ops runbook bullets: - alert on repeated switches - investigate degscore cohorts in telemetry - manual override endpoint /api/v1/quant/override - CLI for SREs: `rictl quant override --svc svc --profile fp8-pref --lock on` - rollback steps.
sam: i'll open a runtime hook PR implementing light signals, cooldown logic, and metrics. will add unit tests for noise resistance.
mike: i'll draft playbook and CLI stub. lia will update infra schema repo.
devops-bot: deploybot: canary start service=llm-inference cfg=quant-autothreshold-2026-03-23
anya: thanks. i'll write the full spec doc with examples and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. closing thread. :thumbsup:
